Stage 5 · Java foundations

Fields & Methods

Fields remember; methods do. Queries read, commands change.

⏱ 14 min🧠 No experience needed🧪 Interactive
Step 1

Memory plus actions

The card remembers so you don’t.

💳

Library card. Fields: name, books held (memory). Methods: borrow(), returnBook() (actions updating memory CORRECTLY).

Book sketch
class Book {
  String title;
  boolean borrowed;
  boolean isAvailable() { return !borrowed; } // query
  void borrow() { borrowed = true; }           // command
  void returnBook() { borrowed = false; }      // command
}
Book b = new Book();
b.title = "Dune";
b.isAvailable(); // true: fresh book
b.borrow();
b.isAvailable(); // false now
Query isAvailable reads; commands borrow/returnBook write. Dot always names the actor.
